  - proof_authority with source_review_pass against 6115225815, including the layout hash and the raw build/prepare/launch hashes;
  - production_source_review against the frozen raw body of 6115334499.
- **The proof itself (234650Z, from 206c4dc4):**
  - status PASSED_NEW_CANDIDATE_NATURAL_KOBO_PROOF;
